news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro (NASDAQ:CLPT) Trading Up 8.3% – Here's Why
news.summary: CLPT shares rose 8.3% to $16.43 intraday in a technical bounce off 200-day EMA support near $15, extending the recovery from the post-earnings selloff though volume was 75% below average and shares remain well off the 52-week high of $30.10.

news.headline: MAK Capital group discloses 7.8% ownership in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: MAK Capital Fund, MAK Capital One, and Michael A. Kaufman reported beneficial ownership of 2,375,861 CLPT shares (7.8%) as of July 27, 2026, up from a 6.3% stake disclosed in May, signaling continued accumulation by the activist-leaning investor.

news.headline: Analysts cut ClearPoint Neuro price targets after Q2 miss (Lake Street to $25, Stifel to $22)
news.summary: Following the Q2 revenue miss and guidance cut, Lake Street lowered its price target to $25 from $30 and Stifel cut its target to $22 from $25, both maintaining bullish ratings; Wall Street Zen separately downgraded the stock to "Strong Sell" days later.

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Unveils Five-Pillar $500M Strategy
news.summary: Q2 revenue came in at $10.9M (+18% YoY) but missed the $12.73M consensus by about $1.8M, prompting a cut to FY26 guidance to $48-52M and a roughly 15% after-hours share drop to about $13; management simultaneously laid out a five-pillar plan targeting $500M in long-term revenue and announced a 10-year focused-ultrasound drug-delivery partnership with Sungkyunkwan University (South Korea).

news.headline: ClearPoint Neuro Congratulates Partner Aspen Neuroscience on FDA RMAT Designation for Sasineprocel
news.summary: Aspen Neuroscience's cell therapy sasineprocel (ANPD001) for Parkinson's disease, delivered via ClearPoint's Navigation System and SmartFlow Cannula, received FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy designation, potentially accelerating its path to approval.

news.headline: BlackRock discloses 7.1% passive stake in ClearPoint Neuro via Schedule 13G/A
news.summary: BlackRock reported a 7.1% passive ownership stake (2,118,912 shares) in CLPT as of June 30, 2026, adding to the roster of large institutional holders alongside MAK Capital during a period of share-price weakness.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint Neuro has historically reported Q3 results in early November; exact date not yet formally announced as of late August 2026.

catalysts.label: uniQure AMT-130 BLA submission (read-through)
catalysts.detail: uniQure intends to submit a BLA for AMT-130 (Huntington's disease), delivered via ClearPoint's navigation platform and SmartFlow cannula, in Q3 2026 after FDA agreed 3-year Phase I/II data could support accelerated approval; a filing would validate ClearPoint's gene-therapy delivery ecosystem.

catalysts.label: Partner clinical data readouts
catalysts.detail: Company has flagged roughly 10 partner clinical/regulatory milestones (data readouts, RMAT/breakthrough designations, filings) expected across its 60+ biopharma partner base.

catalysts.label: First GLP IND-enabling study at CAL
catalysts.detail: ClearPoint's newly acquired Torrey Pines preclinical lab (ClearPoint Advanced Laboratories) has its first GLP statement-of-work study slated for completion in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Potential first commercial cell/gene therapy approvals
catalysts.detail: Management points to potential commercial approvals of partner cell and gene therapies administered via ClearPoint's platform by end-2027, underpinning the long-term $500M revenue strategy.

pulse: CLPT is stabilizing after its post-Q2-earnings plunge, bouncing roughly 8% off 200-day support in late August to the mid-$15 to mid-$16 range, still well below the $30.10 52-week high, amid a still-fractured analyst picture (Lake Street/Stifel cut targets to $25/$22, Wall Street Zen slapped a Strong Sell, while other covering analysts stay bullish). Institutional accumulation continues underneath the volatility, with both MAK Capital (7.8%) and BlackRock (7.1%) disclosing sizeable passive stakes in late July/August. The bull case still rests on the partner pipeline -- Aspen Neuroscience's new FDA RMAT designation and the pending uniQure AMT-130 BLA (Q3 2026) -- validating the five-pillar, $500M long-term revenue strategy management unveiled alongside the guidance cut.
